content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy. Research shows muscle growth is similar across a wide range of loads, from about 5 to 30 reps per set, as long as your sets are taken close to failure (roughly 0-3 reps left in the tank). Lighter weights just need more reps and take more effort to get there.

Your 100 kg bench goal is different, though. It's a strength goal, so you do need to train heavy, around 3-8 reps, to practice the lift. A mix of heavy bench work and moderate-rep accessories will serve both goals. 💪
